crossRefs.note: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the…
The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for…
God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
Don’t be furious, Yahweh. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

translations.web: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
translations.bsb: He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage.
translations.kjv: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
translations.asv: He gave his people over also unto the sword, And was wroth with his inheritance.
